content_html:
The force is with D23

Also: Ahsoka S2 teaser, Doomsday trailer, news about MCU’s X-Men and Star Wars: Starfighter

Credit: Marvel Studios

It was a busy first day at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event, in Anaheim, California, with Marvel Studios releasing the first trailer for VisionQuest. We also got the first teaser for Ahsoka S2; the public release of the Avengers: Doomsday special footage featured last month for attendees only at San Diego Comic-Con; a special sneak peek (for attendees only) for Star Wars: Starfighter; casting news for the MCU’s X-Men movie; and a trailer for an animated special, LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian, coming to Disney+ next month.

(Some spoilers below. One MAJOR spoiler for Spider-Man: Brand New Day; we’ll give you a heads-up when we get there.)

VisionQuest

Marvel’s streaming TV portfolio has kind of been all over the place: a handful of hits, a few misses, and a bunch of middling offerings. One of the standout hits was WandaVision, followed by an excellent sequel (of sorts), Agatha All Along. VisionQuest will complete the trilogy. Yes, Vision (Paul Bettany) died in Infinity War, but WandaVision resurrected an all-white version whose memories were restored in the finale. We finally get to learn what happened afterward.

Per the official premise:

Vision, rebooted and having escaped from those who sought to weaponize him, has been in hiding. Searching for new meaning, he consults the AI personas embedded in his programming, including F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., J.A.R.V.I.S., and the infamous Ultron. His discreet existence ends when a bounty placed on his head thrusts him on the run with Thomas Shepard, a mysterious boy who may be Vision’s son, reincarnate. As Vision evades capture, he must confront his nature, resist Ultron’s influence, and unravel the enigma that is his young companion if he’s to survive.

Naturally Bettany is returning as Vision, along with James Spader as Ultron. Agatha All Along gave us a new Billy Maximoff, whose soul took over the dying body of another teen as Wanda’s spell unraveled at the end of WandaVision. Fans may recall that Agatha helped Bill track down the soul of his twin, Tommy (aka Speed), and place him into the body of a teen boy who drowned, Thomas Shepherd. That storyline is clearly getting picked up in VisionQuest, since Ruaridh Mollica has been cast as Tommy/Thomas Shepherd. Bettany said last year that the series would explore “intergenerational trauma” with fathers and sons.

The cast also includes Todd Stashwick as a bounty hunter named Paradin who is tracking down Vision; T’Nia Miller as a vengeful robot named Jocasta; Emily Hampshire as E.D.I.T.H., aka Tony Stark’s augmented reality security and defense system; Orla Brady as F.R.I.D.A.Y., Stark’s replacement AI system for J.A.R.V.I.S.; and James D’Arcy as J.A.R.V.I.S. (D’Arcy played a human Jarvis serving Stark’s father in Agent Carter.) Henry Lewis and Jonathan Sayer play D.U.M.E. and U, respectively, two of Stark’s robot workshop assistants.

In addition, Lauren Morais plays Lisa Molinari; Diane Morgan plays an associate of Paladin; Cristian Lavin plays a mercenary; and Mary McDonnell will appear in an as-yet-undisclosed role. And Faran Tahir will be back as Raza, leader of the Ten Rings, who kidnapped Tony Stark in 2008’s Iron Man. We thought Raza had died in that film, but we’ll probably see him in a flashback or perhaps just in Vision’s mind.

VisionQuest debuts on October 14, 2026, on Disney+.

Ahsoka S2

The Jedi Padawan of Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka was first introduced as a supporting character in 2008’s animated film Star Wars: The Clone Wars and the subsequent animated series. The character returned in the sequel series Star Wars Rebels (2014-2018) as a member of the Rebel Alliance, operating under the codename Fulcrum, and made numerous other cameo appearances in the extended Star Wars universe. Rosario Dawson’s live-action version made her debut in The Mandalorian‘s second season. She also appeared briefly in The Book of Boba Fett.

And then she got her own series, Ahsoka, set in the same timeframe as The Mandalorian. In the first season, Ahsoka teamed up with her former apprentice, Sabine Wren (Natasha Liu Bordizzo) to prevent Grand Admiral Thrawn (Lars Mikkelson) from returning from the galaxy in which he was stranded, lest he unite what remains of the Galactic Empire and take down the fledgling New Republic. The season ended with Ahsoka and Sabine stranded in the same galaxy and a returned Thrawn taking up arms against the New Republic.

Per the official S2 premise: “Season 2 continues the story of Ahsoka Tano and her extraordinary journey beyond the known galaxy. As Ahsoka and her Jedi apprentice Sabine Wren travel across a mysterious and perilous world to find their way home, their friends Hera, Ezra, Zeb, and Chopper, must face the powerful Grand Admiral Thrawn and his sinister allies, who seek to plunge the New Republic into war.”

Dawson, Bordizzo, and Mikkelson are back for S2, of course, along with Hayden Christensen as Anakin Skywalker, Mary Elizabeth Winstead as Hera Syndulla, Eman Esfandi as Ezra Bridger, Ivanna Sakhno as Shin Hati, David Tennant as Huyang, Dave Filoni as Chopper;, and Elden Bennett as Admiral Akbar. Rory McCann (Game of Thrones) replaces Ray Stevenson as Baylan Skoll (the actor died in 2023). As the logline confirms, “Zeb” Orrelios will also appear in S2.

The second season of Ahsoka will premiere on January 20, 2027, on Disney+.

Avengers: Doomsday

Marvel dropped the first full trailer for Doomsday a few days before San Diego Comic-Con last month, and unveiled an exclusive “special look” at additional footage for SDCC attendees. The rest of us are finally getting to see that footage.

The film takes place 14 months after the events of Thunderbolts*. Per the official logline: “Beloved heroes from three distinct universes will be set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they’ve ever encountered.” Those universes are Earth-616 (the Avengers, Wakandans, and New Avengers), Earth-828 (Fantastic Four), and the “original” X-Men (more on this below).

In the footage, we learn more about Robert Downey Jr.’s Victor von Doom character via a voiceover by Sue Reed (Vanessa Kirby). Victor was an old friend, the smartest guy in the room, and Sue assures us that “he used to be different” before “everything he loved was taken from him. I knew he was lost. But I did not realize he was broken.” Dr. Doom’s voiceover accuses our star-studded ensemble cast of living “stolen lives,” and insists that “now you must give them back.” This does not bode well for anyone.

Avengers: Doomsday hits theaters on December 18, 2026.

Star Wars: Starfighter

We haven’t gotten an official teaser yet for Star Wars: Starfighter, directed by Shawn Levy (Deadpool and Wolverine) and starring Ryan Gosling—or even much in the way of concrete details. But D23 attendees—including several media outlets—were treated to some exclusive first footage, with both Levy and Gosling taking the stage to introduce said footage.

Levy described the film as being “full of humor, danger, and spectacle, but above all the joyous spirit that has always been the beating heart of this legacy that we all love so much.” As for the story, it’s brand new, not related at all to the two trilogies that make up the Skywalker Saga. Gosling said it was about a character “from the wrong side of the galaxy whose fate is intertwined with the fastest starfighter ever built.” The film takes place five or six years after The Rise of Skywalker on a watery planet. That’s a period that hasn’t yet been depicted in the franchise, so Levy and his production team had to come up with new sets and designs that were still consistent with the overall feel of Star Wars.

Star Wars: Starfighter hits theaters on May 28, 2027—50 years (almost to the day) after the original movie, Star Wars: A New Hope, debuted.

(WARNING: MAJOR spoiler for Spider-Man: Brand New Day below. Stop reading now if you haven’t seen the film.)

The X-Men in the MCU

Mutants are finally coming to the MCU with X-Men, a planned reboot of the franchise directed by Jake Schreier (Thunderbolts*) slated for a 2028 release. Marvel is already setting the stage, beginning with the identity of Sadie Sink’s mysterious cloaked figure in Spider-Man: Brand New Day. Spoiler alert: she plays a young Jean Grey, as much victim as villain.

Joining Sink will be Christopher Abbott (Wolf Man) as Charles Xavier/Professor X; Kit Connor (Heartstopper) as Cyclops; Samara Weaving (Ready or Not) as Emma Frost; Maya Boyd as Storm, Inde Navarrette (Obsession) as Rogue; and Adam Driver (Rise of Skywalker) as Nathan Milbury, aka Mister Sinister. There had been rumors that Charles Melton had been cast as Dr. Hank McCoy/Beast but later dropped out of the project. We can expect more casting news in the coming months.

X-Men is coming to theaters on May 5 , 2028.

LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian

This animated special is described as a “comedic retelling of all three seasons” of the live-action series The Mandalorian, with Gavin Hammon voicing The Mandalorian.

The cast also includes David Acord as Grogu/MA-13; Amy Sedaris as Peli Motto; Bill Burr as Migs; David Pasquesi as Majordomo; Katee Sackhoff as Bo-Katan Kryze; Emily Swallow as the Armorer; Giancarlo Esposito as Moff Gideon; Ming-Na Wen as Fennec Shand; Nick Nolte as Kuiil; Rosario Dawson as Ahsoka Tano; Taika Waititi as IG-11/IG-12; Temeura Morrison as Boba Fett; Timothy Olyphant as Cobb Vanth; Carl Lumbly as Greef Karga; Eric Bauza as Luke Skywalker/EV-9D9; Flula Borg as The Client; Marti Matulis as Vane; and Paul Sun-Hyung Lee as Carson Teva.

LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian is coming to Disney+ on September 2, 2026. Disney is also launching an official Mandalorian and Grogu podcast that day, which is also when the film arrives on the streaming platform.

Jennifer is a senior writer at Ars Technica with a particular focus on where science meets culture, covering everything from physics and related interdisciplinary topics to her favorite films and TV series. Jennifer lives in Baltimore with her spouse, physicist Sean M. Carroll, and their two cats, Ariel and Caliban.

blocks.html_en: Naturally Bettany is returning as Vision, along with James Spader as Ultron. blocks.html_en: The Jedi Padawan of Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka was first introduced as a supporting character in 2008’s animated film Star Wars: The Clone Wars and the subsequent animated series. The character returned in the sequel series Star Wars Rebels (2014-2018) as a member of the Rebel Alliance, operating under the codename Fulcrum, and made numerous other cameo appearances in the extended Star Wars universe. Rosario Dawson’s live-action version made her debut in The Mandalorian‘s second season. She also appeared briefly in The Book of Boba Fett.

sentences.en: The Jedi Padawan of Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka was first introduced as a supporting character in 2008’s animated film Star Wars: The Clone Wars and the subsequent animated series.

sentences.en: The character returned in the sequel series Star Wars Rebels (2014-2018) as a member of the Rebel Alliance, operating under the codename Fulcrum, and made numerous other cameo appearances in the extended Star Wars universe.
sentences.zh: 该角色在续集《星球大战：义军崛起》（2014-2018）中作为义军联盟的成员回归，代号为支点，并在扩展的星球大战宇宙中客串了许多次。

sentences.en: Rosario Dawson’s live-action version made her debut in The Mandalorian‘s second season.
sentences.zh: 罗莎里奥·道森的真人版在《曼达洛人》第二季中首次亮相。

sentences.en: She also appeared briefly in The Book of Boba Fett.
sentences.zh: 她还曾短暂出现在《波巴·费特之书》中。

blocks.html_en: And then she got her own series, Ahsoka, set in the same timeframe as The Mandalorian. In the first season, Ahsoka teamed up with her former apprentice, Sabine Wren (Natasha Liu Bordizzo) to prevent Grand Admiral Thrawn (Lars Mikkelson) from returning from the galaxy in which he was stranded, lest he unite what remains of the Galactic Empire and take down the fledgling New Republic. The season ended with Ahsoka and Sabine stranded in the same galaxy and a returned Thrawn taking up arms against the New Republic.

blocks.html_en: In the footage, we learn more about Robert Downey Jr.’s Victor von Doom character via a voiceover by Sue Reed (Vanessa Kirby). blocks.html_en: Levy described the film as being “full of humor, danger, and spectacle, but above all the joyous spirit that has always been the beating heart of this legacy that we all love so much.” As for the story, it’s brand new, not related at all to the two trilogies that make up the Skywalker Saga. Gosling said it was about a character “from the wrong side of the galaxy whose fate is intertwined with the fastest starfighter ever built.” The film takes place five or six years after The Rise of Skywalker on a watery planet. That’s a period that hasn’t yet been depicted in the franchise, so Levy and his production team had to come up with new sets and designs that were still consistent with the overall feel of Star Wars.

力与D23

另外：阿索卡 S2 预告片、世界末日预告片、有关 MCU 的 X 战警和星球大战：星际战斗机的新闻

图片来源：漫威影业

D23：加州阿纳海姆终极迪士尼粉丝活动的第一天非常忙碌，漫威影业发布了《VisionQuest》的第一部预告片。 我们还得到了 Ahsoka S2 的第一个预告片；上个月，仅在圣地亚哥动漫展上向与会者公开发布了《复仇者联盟：世界末日》的特别片段； 《星球大战：星际战斗机》特别抢先体验（仅限与会者）；漫威电影宇宙 X 战警电影的选角新闻；动画特别片《乐高星球大战：曼达洛人》的预告片将于下个月登陆 Disney+。

（以下有部分剧透。 《蜘蛛侠：全新的一天》的一大剧透；当我们到达那里时，我们会提前通知您。）

视觉探索

漫威的流媒体电视产品组合有点五花八门：一些热门，一些失败，还有一堆中等的产品。 其中最热门的作品之一是《旺达幻视》，随后是一部出色的续集（某种意义上），《阿加莎一直》。 VisionQuest 将完成三部曲。 是的，幻视（保罗·贝坦尼饰）在《无限战争》中死去，但旺达幻视复活了一个全白版本，其记忆在结局中恢复。 我们终于知道后来发生了什么。

根据官方前提：

幻视重新启动并逃离了那些试图将他武器化的人，一直躲藏起来。 为了寻找新的意义，他查阅了程序中嵌入的人工智能角色，包括 F.R.I.D.A.Y.、E.D.I.T.H.、J.A.R.V.I.S. 和臭名昭著的 Ultron。 当悬赏悬赏给他的头时，他与托马斯·谢泼德（Thomas Shepard）一起逃亡，他谨慎的存在结束了，托马斯·谢泼德是一个神秘的男孩，可能是幻视的儿子转世。 当幻视逃避抓捕时，如果他想生存下去，他就必须面对自己的本性，抵抗奥创的影响，并解开他年轻同伴的谜团。

当然，贝坦尼将回归饰演幻视，詹姆斯·斯派德饰演奥创。 《阿加莎始终》给了我们一个新的比利·马克西莫夫，当旺达的咒语在《旺达幻视》的结尾解开时，他的灵魂接管了另一个青少年垂死的身体。 粉丝们可能还记得，阿加莎帮助比尔追踪他的双胞胎汤米（又名斯皮德）的灵魂，并将他放入溺水男孩托马斯·谢泼德的体内。 这个故事情节显然在 VisionQuest 中得到了体现，因为 Ruaridh Mollica 已被选为汤米/托马斯·谢泼德。 贝坦尼去年表示，该剧将探讨父子之间的“代际创伤”。

演员阵容还包括托德·斯塔什维克（Todd Stashwick）饰演赏金猎人帕拉丁（Paradin），他正在追踪幻视； T’Nia Miller 饰演一个名叫 Jocasta 的复仇机器人； Emily Hampshire 饰演 E.D.I.T.H.，又名托尼·斯塔克的增强现实安全和防御系统；奥拉·布雷迪 (Orla Brady) 饰演 F.R.I.D.A.Y.，斯塔克替代贾维斯 (J.A.R.V.I.S.) 的人工智能系统；詹姆斯·达西饰演 J.A.R.V.I.S. （达西在《卡特特工》中扮演了为斯塔克父亲服务的人类贾维斯。） 亨利·刘易斯 (Henry Lewis) 和乔纳森·塞耶 (Jonathan Sayer) 饰演 D.U.M.E. U和U分别是斯塔克的机器人车间助理。

此外，劳伦·莫莱斯 (Lauren Morais) 饰演丽莎·莫利纳里 (Lisa Molinari)；黛安·摩根 (Diane Morgan) 饰演帕拉丁 (Paladin) 的同事；克里斯蒂安·拉文 (Cristian Lavin) 饰演一名雇佣兵；玛丽·麦克唐纳将出演一个尚未公开的角色。 法兰·塔希尔 (Faran Tahir) 将回归饰演十环领袖拉扎 (Raza)，他在 2008 年的《钢铁侠》中绑架了托尼·斯塔克 (Tony Stark)。 我们以为拉扎在那部电影中已经死了，但我们可能会在闪回中或者只是在幻视的脑海中看到他。

VisionQuest 于 2026 年 10 月 14 日在 Disney+ 首次亮相。

阿索卡S2

阿索卡是阿纳金·天行者的绝地学徒，首次作为配角出现在 2008 年的动画电影《星球大战：克隆人战争》和随后的动画系列中。 该角色在续集《星球大战：义军崛起》（2014-2018）中作为义军联盟的成员回归，代号为支点，并在扩展的星球大战宇宙中客串了许多次。 罗莎里奥·道森的真人版在《曼达洛人》第二季中首次亮相。 她还曾短暂出现在《波巴·费特之书》中。

然后她有了自己的剧集《阿索卡》，故事背景与《曼达洛人》同一时间段。 在第一季中，阿索卡与她以前的学徒萨宾·雷恩（娜塔莎·刘·博迪佐饰）联手阻止索龙元帅（拉尔斯·米克尔森饰）从被困的银河系返回，以免他联合银河帝国的残余力量并推翻刚刚起步的新共和国。 本季结束时，阿索卡和萨宾被困在同一个星系，归来的索龙拿起武器对抗新共和国。

根据 S2 的官方前提：“第二季继续讲述阿索卡·塔诺的故事以及她超越已知星系的非凡旅程。 当阿索卡和她的绝地学徒萨宾·雷恩穿越一个神秘而危险的世界寻找回家的路时，他们的朋友赫拉、埃兹拉、泽布和乔巴必须面对强大的索龙元帅和他险恶的盟友，他们试图让新共和国陷入战争。

当然，道森、博迪佐和米克尔森也回归了《S2》，此外还有海登·克里斯滕森饰演阿纳金·天行者、玛丽·伊丽莎白·文斯蒂德饰演赫拉·辛杜拉、伊曼·埃斯凡迪饰演埃兹拉·布里杰、伊万娜·萨赫诺饰演辛·哈蒂、大卫·田纳特饰演胡阳、戴夫·费洛尼饰演乔巴；以及埃尔登·贝内特饰演阿克巴上将。 罗里·麦肯（《权力的游戏》）取代雷·史蒂文森饰演贝兰·斯科尔（该演员于 2023 年去世）。 正如剧情证实的那样，“Zeb”Orrelios 也将出现在 S2 中。

《阿索卡》第二季将于 2027 年 1 月 20 日在 Disney+ 首播。

复仇者联盟：世界末日

上个月，漫威在圣地亚哥动漫展前几天发布了《世界末日》的首部完整预告片，并为 SDCC 与会者推出了额外的“特别镜头”。 我们其他人终于可以看到这段视频了。

这部电影的故事发生在《雷霆万钧》* 事件发生 14 个月后。 根据官方的剧情简介：“来自三个不同宇宙的心爱英雄将踏上致命的碰撞路线，并面临他们从未遇到过的生存威胁。” 这些宇宙是 Earth-616（复仇者联盟、瓦坎丹人和新复仇者联盟）、Earth-828（神奇四侠）和“最初的”X 战警（更多内容见下文）。

在这段视频中，我们通过苏·里德（凡妮莎·柯比饰）的画外音了解了更多关于小罗伯特·唐尼饰演的维克多·冯·末日角色的信息。 维克多是一位老朋友，是房间里最聪明的人，苏向我们保证，在“他所爱的一切都被夺走”之前，“他曾经是不同的”。 我知道他迷路了。 但我没有意识到他已经崩溃了。” 毁灭博士的画外音指责我们众星云集的演员们过着“被偷走的生活”，并坚称“现在你必须把他们还给他们”。 这对任何人来说都不是好兆头。

《复仇者联盟：世界末日》将于 2026 年 12 月 18 日上映。

星球大战：星际战斗机

我们还没有收到由肖恩·利维（《死侍》和《金刚狼》）执导、瑞恩·高斯林主演的《星球大战：星际战斗机》的官方预告片，甚至还没有具体细节。 但 D23 与会者——包括几家媒体——都观看了一些独家的第一段视频，利维和高斯林都上台介绍了这些视频。

利维将这部电影描述为“充满幽默、危险和奇观，但最重要的是欢乐精神，它一直是我们都非常喜爱的这一遗产的跳动核心。” 至于故事，它是全新的，与构成天行者传奇的两部三部曲完全无关。 高斯林表示，这是关于一个“来自银河系另一端的角色，他的命运与有史以来最快的星际战斗机交织在一起”。 这部电影发生在天行者崛起五六年后的一个水星球上。 这是一个尚未在系列中描绘的时期，因此利维和他的制作团队必须想出新的布景和设计，这些布景和设计仍然与《星球大战》的整体感觉保持一致。

《星球大战：星际战斗机》将于 2027 年 5 月 28 日上映，距原版电影《星球大战：新希望》首映 50 年（几乎是同一天）。

（警告：下面是《蜘蛛侠：全新的一天》的主要剧透。 如果您还没有看过这部电影，请立即停止阅读。）

MCU 中的 X 战警

变种人终于与《X 战警》一起来到漫威宇宙，这部由杰克·施赖尔（《雷电》*）执导的系列电影的重启计划预计于 2028 年上映。 漫威已经做好了准备，从《蜘蛛侠：崭新的一天》中萨迪·辛克神秘的斗篷人物的身份开始。 剧透警告：她扮演年轻的琴·格雷，既是受害者又是恶棍。

克里斯托弗·阿博特 (Christopher Abbott)（《狼人》）将加盟《辛克》，饰演查尔斯·泽维尔 (Charles Xavier)/X 教授；基特·康纳（Heartstopper）饰演独眼巨人；萨马拉·维文（《准备好与否》）饰演艾玛·弗罗斯特；玛雅·博伊德（Maya Boyd）饰演暴风女，印德·纳瓦雷特（Inde Navarrette）（《痴迷》）饰演盗贼；亚当·德赖弗（《天行者崛起》）饰演内森·米尔伯里，又名险恶先生。 曾有传言称查尔斯·梅尔顿曾被选为汉克·麦考伊博士/野兽，但后来退出了该项目。 我们可以期待未来几个月更多的选角消息。

《X 战警》将于 2028 年 5 月 5 日上映。
